(b) Ghost '$' on mobile projects: FIXED. Only Project and Status show, with no stray glyph on any row (dashboard/screenshots/projects-mobile-light.png, Billing Revamp, Apollo Migration and Vendor Portal included). (c) About-page blueprints: FIXED, measured. On blog/screenshots/about-desktop-dark.png (1440px, displayed at 1001px, ×1.44), the stack spans x≈42–233, about 275 CSS px. The connected pair spans x≈361–552, about 275px, and the box x≈680–870, about 274px. The light theme matches (about-desktop-light.png). In rc.1 and the published version these were about 188–190px. On mobile (about-mobile-light.png, ×4.02 at 2x) each figure is about 328 CSS px in a 350px column, about 94%. The native crops confirm a filled frame: blog/drawings/about-d1.png, the figure at about 273px of the crop. The row is also no longer three look-alike stacks: it is a stack, a connected pair with a dashed connector, and a box (FIXED, see the variety item below). Craft compared with p1-i5: the app's slabs are clean single outlines with a dot grid. The reference's stack has many thin inner ribs and dotted verticals, so it is richer, but the app's version is a fair simplification and not a defect. Harness note, not penalized: the drawing crops are numbered out of visual order (drawings/about-d2.png shows the box and about-d3.png shows the pair, while the page has FIG 0.2 = pair).

Compared with the published version (0.1.0-rc.3/*/20261017-095917), what got worse, all small. (1) Product detail now has two figure numbers on one plate: 'FIG 01 · 18 OZ COTTON CANVAS' inside the plate and 'FIG 0.1' in the caption right below it (commerce/screenshots/products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-light.png y≈691 and 757, products-merino-crew-sweater-mobile-dark.png 'FIG 04' / 'FIG 0.4'). In 1.0.0 the plate said 'BAGS' and the caption 'FIG 0.1', with no clash (0.1.0-rc.3/commerce/.../products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-light.png). On mobile the product name then appears twice within about 150px (caption 'Canvas Field Tote A roomy…' directly above the h1). (2) Product detail lost the 'BAGS · IN STOCK' meta and the mono 01/02/03 numbers on the Details rows (same comparison). The plain rows read more generic. (3) The blog header lost its brand icon. The agent says the spec asks for plain text, so this is acceptable. Nothing that regressed in rc.1 is still regressed.

Other remaining issues, none blocking. (a) Blog closing statement is about 32px against the spec's 'Closing statement: display size' (agent.md Typography, Signature 6 → Where). The agent overrode this on purpose (blog/agent-report.md 'Closing statement: it's 32px…'). Commerce uses the 72px display statement (commerce/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png 'Free shipping over $100.'), so the two closings differ across apps. The reference closes at display size (reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png 'Built for the future. Available today.'). The published version had the same 32px blog closing, so this is not a regression. (b) The 'Color' and 'Size' legends sit about 2px right of every other left edge, a default fieldset legend padding (commerce/products-canvas-field-tote-mobile-light.png x≈33 vs 30). (c) Dashboard mobile KPI cards: 'DEPLOYMENTS THIS MONTH' wraps to two lines, so its value sits about 9 CSS px lower than its neighbour's (dashboard/screenshots/state-empty-filter-mobile-light.png, 186 vs 99.94%). (d) Settings profile: the preview stage is wider than the form above it in the same right column (settings/screenshots/settings-profile-desktop-dark.png, form ends x≈1231, stage x≈1407). (e) In the cart empty state the description breaks onto a lone 'like.' (commerce/screenshots/cart-desktop-dark.png). (f) Plate motifs repeat within one grid: floor grid on NO. 02 and NO. 07 in blog, and globe, floor grid, fan and matrix twice each in the 11-item commerce grid. This is generative variety at the low end, and the reference does not repeat a motif within one row. (g) Process, not scored: blog and settings load Inter and Geist Mono from Google Fonts while commerce and dashboard self-host them. The spec says nothing on this. The blog agent did not run the spec's blueprint measurement ('checked by eye', blog/agent-report.md), although the result is right.

Reference fidelity (4): the language reads as the reference's without copying it. Near-black ground, inverse pills, Inter 510/590 with tight tracking, mono uppercase captions, two-tone statements, large split openers down content pages, hairline grids of generative plates, the dot-column chart on a quiet stage with the teal highlight, and the dot-field closings (dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png, commerce/home-desktop-dark.png, blog/about-desktop-dark.png vs reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png). Not a 5: the lit stage with product UI has no home in these apps, which the spec allows, and the blueprints are simpler than the reference's ribbed stacks (p1-i5.png).

Cross-app consistency (4): one family. Screen heads with mono labels, the '01 / 02' app section heads (settings, cart), hairline tables, the danger banner on every form (blog newsletter included), the empty glyph, and the blueprint vocabulary are all shared. Palette consistency is 0.969 and type consistency 0.886 (eval-1.md), better than rc.1's 0.851. Drift: closing statement size (blog 32px vs commerce 72px), and the double FIG numbering only on commerce detail.

Hierarchy (4): restored. Content pages open each section with the 48px split opener and a description (blog/home-desktop-dark.png 'More posts', about-desktop-dark.png), as the reference does (p1-desktop-light.png). App screens read screen head, then KPIs, then chart and activity, then table (dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png). Product detail reads name, price, options, Add to cart. One weakness: the mobile product page repeats the name in the plate caption above the h1.

Spacing rhythm (4): the 4/8 scale holds. App padding 32, KPI gap 16, settings groups about 48 apart with a hairline above, equal table rows on desktop and mobile. The gap between the Plans group and Payment method is larger than the other group gaps (settings/settings-billing-desktop-light.png, about 80px vs 48px), which is minor.

Component states (4): focus is the 1px indigo outline plus accent border, layered over the red error border (commerce/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png, blog/state-newsletter-error-desktop-dark.png). Focus on the nav pill (commerce/state-keyboard-focus-desktop-dark.png 'Cart'). The empty filter shows the glyph, 'NO RESULTS', a two-tone line and 'Clear filters' (dashboard/state-empty-filter-mobile-light.png). The plan dialog is a bottom sheet on mobile with a mono label, a 590 title, an inverse Confirm and a bordered Cancel (settings/state-plan-dialog-mobile-light.png). Chart-in motion runs 420ms on the standard curve with the columns rising (dashboard/motion/motion-m1.png).

Polish (4): the four rc.1 leftovers (nav clip, radio circles, double rules, demoted openers) are gone. What remains is small: the sessions row still cuts 'Active now' (spec gap, see promptFixes), the double FIG numbering on product detail, the legend indent, the STATUS head misalignment in the mobile pin, the KPI label wrap, and the orphan word in the empty cart. This is about the published version's level, which scored 4.

Signature (4): every element is in all four apps and placed as Applying the concept says. That covers plates with fact captions (commerce, blog), quiet stages (dashboard chart, product detail, settings preview), dot glyphs and dot meters (team load, password strength), tier slabs on plans (settings/drawings/settings-billing-d1..d3.png), the about row of three at about 275px with a stack, a connected pair and a box, the empty slab stack (commerce/cart), dot-field closings, and the chart motion. Not a 5: the blog closing is not at display size, the blueprint craft is simpler than the reference's (blog/drawings/about-d1.png vs reference/illustrations/p1-i5.png), and plate motifs repeat within a grid.

Not penalized (known harness gaps and base-app content): no real pending request, so no scan glyph, shimmer or loading button was captured. Sticky headers and dialog scrims appear mid-page in full-page captures (commerce/state-checkout-errors-mobile-light.png, settings/state-plan-dialog-mobile-light.png, dashboard/state-empty-filter-mobile-light.png). Motion frames come only from the first route, so the about-page pair connector was not captured moving. 'Account Settings', title-case data and the always-visible '0' cart count come from the base apps.

Bar: 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, an average of 4.0 with nothing below 3, which clears the bar. The update reached all three goals: (a), (b) and (c), with (c) measured at about 275px against a 270px target. It also fixed every rc.1 issue except two: the sessions-row truncation, which the spec's own markup causes, and the leftover ReviewPage stub, which the run's permissions caused. The fixes below are non-blocking and worth taking before or after publishing.
promptFixes: Polish, non-blocking; spec gap (the agent followed 'then a row badge (flex:none)'): under Table → Small screens, change the row-badge rule to: 'A badge naming the row goes on the first line, inline after the primary value (inside the first span, `margin-left:space.8`); under `breakpoint.sm` it shows as its 6px dot only, with the label kept for screen readers (`.badge-label{position:absolute;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}`), so the second line keeps its full width. Never let a badge shorten the second line.' Add to Verification: 'At 390px, the second line of a row with a badge is not cut.' Evidence: settings/20261017-161614/screenshots/settings-security-mobile-dark.png ('New York, US · Active no…' beside 'This device').

Polish, non-blocking; spec gap: under Table → Small screens, add: 'The pin's head label is one short word, or is visually hidden when the pin holds a number (`sr-only`). The pin is never wider than its widest value plus `space.24`. The pin head aligns like its cells (right).' Evidence: dashboard/20261017-161614/screenshots/team-mobile-dark.png (an 'ACTIVE PROJECTS' head makes a 131px pin for one digit while emails are cut) and projects-mobile-light.png ('STATUS' left-aligned over right-aligned values).

Signature/consistency, non-blocking; the spec says it but the agent overrode it: move 'Closing statement: `display` size (`clamp(h2, 6vw, display)`), 1 to 2 sentences; long newsletter copy goes in the form's helper line, never in the statement' into the Never list as 'a closing statement under `font.size.h2`'. Evidence: blog/20261017-161614/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png and about-desktop-dark.png (about 32px, the agent's 'three sentences' reason in blog/agent-report.md) vs commerce/home-desktop-dark.png (72px) and reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png.

Evidence: blog/20261017-161614/screenshots/home-desktop-dark.png (floor grid on NO. 02 and NO. 07) and commerce/home-desktop-dark.png (globe, floor grid, fan and matrix twice each across 11 cards).

Process, non-blocking, harness and spec: the ReviewPage stub was left because the run could not delete files. Either allow `rm` of files the agent itself created in the harness run's allowed commands (packages/harness), or tell the agent in Verification to build review pieces only under `src/__review__/` and to report that folder if it cannot delete it. Separately, add one line under Root setup: 'Fonts: self-host Inter and Geist Mono (npm font packages or local files); no font CDN', so all four apps load fonts the same way. Evidence: dashboard/20261017-161614/app/src/pages/ReviewPage.tsx and dashboard/agent-report.md; blog/agent-report.md and settings/agent-report.md (Google Fonts) vs commerce/agent-report.md (self-hosted).
